name: bubbles-coordinated-motion-domains
instr:
Bubbles cannot currently coordinate animation and time-based widgets through shared motion domains. Add domains that pause, resume, and advance deterministically, so widgets move together without affecting other domains and applications that do not opt in keep existing behavior.

A `motion.Controller` from `charm.land/bubbles/v2/motion` owns a stable identity, running state, and generation shared consistently by attached models. Pause and resume must atomically invalidate earlier work. Stale or foreign `motion.Msg` values must not change state or schedule successors. Resume schedules fresh work only for active models, without replaying elapsed time.

A step advances each eligible attached cursor, spinner, progress spring, timer, and stopwatch by exactly one native interval while the domain stays paused. Stepping a running domain does nothing. Progress keeps spring continuity and becomes idle at equilibrium. Timers notify exactly once upon exhaustion. Stopwatches honor independent stopped and reset states.

The `WithController` option in `cursor`, `spinner`, `progress`, `timer`, `stopwatch`, `list`, `textinput`, and `textarea` attaches the model and its owned animated children. `cursor.New`, `spinner.New`, `textinput.New`, and `textarea.New` accept motion options without changing established defaults. While paused, list navigation and editor focus, movement, blink reset, rendering, and update ordering remain usable, while owned spinners and cursors freeze and step together.

C
